acceptance: Each listed client is updated and rejects the checker hosts at emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com, or is removed
/etc/ssl/cert.pem still lacks both affected roots after the next macOS update
description:
After the 2026-10-23 updates, these clients on the maintainer's Mac still embed emSign ECC Root CA - G3 (or AAA Certificate Services) or could not be checked:
- omp (Bun-built): Homebrew omp 18.9.1 and the installed 18.12.6. Bun 1.4.4 is the fixed runtime.
- memex, installed with cargo from ~/Developer/memex, whose Cargo.lock pins webpki-roots 1.0.4 (fixed in 1.0.10).
- DataGrip's bundled Java runtime (JBR 25.0.3), Gemini.app's gRPC roots and Homebrew's portable Ruby certificate file.
- Electron apps below the fixed Electron versions, not scanned: VS Code, Cursor, Antigravity, Discord, GitHub Desktop and Omnigent.
- uv-managed CPython 3.10.22 bundles pip 23.0.1 in ensurepip, so `python3.10 -m venv` seeds a vulnerable pip; 3.10 is end of life and unused, so uninstalling it is an option.

Also re-check `/etc/ssl/cert.pem` after each macOS update: two roots were removed from it by hand (backup at /etc/ssl/cert.pem.bak-emsign), and an update may restore the old file.
